entry.title: dotnet/efcore - Issues & Pull Requests - 2026-06-23
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • EF Core 10 parameter-name simplification (@__p_0 → @p) and SQL Server plan-cache recompilation on upgrade #38483

Closed

  • xml constants do not have the N prefix #38429
    11.0.0
  • Cosmos: review cast/convert handling #34982
    11.0.0
  • Cosmos does not translate string concat where at least 1 parameter needs to be converted to a string #34963
    Backlog

PullRequests

Created

  • Make primitive collection element type a creation-time concern #38484

Merged

  • [release/10.0] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet #38475
  • [main] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet #38477
  • Fix NullReferenceException materializing JSON owned collections with nested primitive collections under lazy-loading proxies #38473
  • Fix XML parameter encoding for SQL Server #38462
  • Better cast/convert support for Cosmos #35000
    community-contribution

Updated

  • Generate and upload code coverage reports in Build.yml, azure-pipelines-public.yml, and azure-pipelines-internal-tests.yml #38482
  • Reuse CosmosTypeMapping.Default for primitive JSON reader/writers #38481
  • Fix invalid shadow property names in precompiled queries and JSON discriminator metadata #38458
  • Unskip tests that aren't failing anymore #38474
  • Add enum and comparison translators for cosmos #35405
    community-contribution
  • Lift try..catch out of an expression and replace with a temporary variable #34912
    community-contribution
  • Fix alter column type JSON to nVarchar #38464
    community-contribution
  • Materialize a left-joined non-entity projection as null on no-match (#30915) #38479
    community-contribution
